question: Why did the error rate go up on 26 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The catalog feature flag change led to increased error rate.
why_chain: The catalog feature flag was changed to 50% in eu-west, causing the service to behave differently.
This change affected the catalog service, leading to a higher error rate as the system tried to handle the new configuration.
The error rate increased from 0.38% to 3.01% after the change, indicating the change had a direct impact on the error rate.

contributing_factors.description: The upstream catalog-db service was experiencing issues, causing timeouts and errors.
why_chain: The catalog service was experiencing timeouts and errors due to upstream catalog-db service issues.
These issues caused the service to return HTTP 503, leading to a higher error rate.
The error rate increased from 0.38% to 3.01% after the change, indicating the upstream service issues were the root cause.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in request volume caused the error rate to go up.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume did not change significantly, and the error rate increased after the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in p95 latency caused the error rate to go up.
ruled_out.reason: The p95 latency increased, but the error rate increased after the change, indicating the latency increase was a symptom, not a cause.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service catalog rose from 0.38% to 3.01% (+695%), with a change point at 2026-03-26T11:35:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service catalog: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.08).
At the same time, request volume for service catalog stayed about the same (1638 per 5 min before, 2024 per 5 min after, +24%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service catalog rose (121 ms before, 217 ms after, +80%).
Upstream catalog-db returning HTTP 503 for catalog (catalog; 2 min after the change; record R013; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
Changed catalog feature flag new_ui_flow to 50% in eu-west (catalog, eu-west; 2 min before the change; record R012; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
catalog: ERROR upstream catalog-db timeout after 3 retries (catalog, eu-west; 14 min after the change; record R014; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
catalog: ERROR upstream catalog-db timeout after 3 retries (catalog, us-east; 14 min after the change; record R015; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
catalog: ERROR upstream catalog-db timeout after 3 retries (catalog, ap-south; 16 min after the change; record R016; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
